purpose: Workload-input corpus schema. Contains no policy outcomes, oracle labels, or policy-comparison fields.

identity.name: source_version
identity.description: Release/commit/revision identifier for the source, where discoverable.

identity.name: source_record_id
identity.description: Native row/record identifier if the source provides one; otherwise the 0-indexed row position, disclosed as DETERMINISTIC_DERIVED.

identity.name: source_url_or_repo
identity.description: Authoritative URL (GitHub/HuggingFace/institutional) the record was pulled from.

identity.name: source_license
identity.description: SPDX identifier or plain-text license label recorded at ingestion time.

identity.name: source_file_sha256
identity.description: SHA-256 of the raw source file this record was derived from.

timing.name: arrival_timestamp
timing.description: Native absolute or relative timestamp, in the source's own units, before normalization.

timing.name: relative_arrival_time
timing.description: Seconds since the first record in the source, t0 = 0.0.

timing.name: interarrival_time
timing.description: relative_arrival_time[i] - relative_arrival_time[i-1] within the same source partition; null for the first record.

size.name: total_tokens
size.description: Native if the source provides it directly, else prompt_tokens + output_tokens when both are NATIVE.

model_context.name: model_family
model_context.description: Only populated if the source explicitly supplies a family label; never inferred from model_name.

model_context.name: generation_params
model_context.description: Namespaced map of any disclosed generation parameters (temperature, max_tokens, etc.).

workload_context.name: prefix_cache_id
workload_context.description: Native prefix/KV-block hash identifiers where the source supplies them.

source_specific.name: extra
source_specific.description: Namespaced map preserving any native fields not mapped to a canonical column above. Never dropped.

invariants: No field is fabricated; unavailable fields are null with field_provenance=UNAVAILABLE.
relative_arrival_time is monotonically non-decreasing within a single source partition (temporal ordering preserved; no shuffling).
No policy-outcome, oracle, regret, or six-policy-utility field may appear in this schema.

actual_output_tokens leakage rule from canonical_schema.py does not apply at this layer (this is a workload-input table, not a scheduler-visible ObservableRequest); output_tokens here is descriptive corpus content, not scheduler input.
